en.balanceEnabledHint: When enabled, this pet plays balance animations and shows the balance bubble.
en.chatImageLimitHint: How many memes at most are listed to the model during chat ("first N" = the first N you wrote in the config, so move the ones you want sent to the front). That whole list is attached to every message and tokens grow linearly with the count, so a long list is pure burn; capping it to the first N makes the model pick only among those. 0 = no limit (send everything). Built-in default 10. Global default, shared by every pet (a pet pack may override it in its own kind file). Chat only — a whisper carries just the one meme it drew.
en.chatImageToggleHint: Let the AI pick one meme from the pool that fits the current context (optional; mapping lives in the top-level `memes` config field). Tokens: every message carries the whole catalog — currently ~1.1k chars (~650 tokens, about 11x the whisper case) and growing with the number of images; turning this off appends nothing at all.
en.chatMemoryHint: How many recent rounds each chat request carries (1 round = 1 question + 1 answer; 0 = no history, every message starts fresh). The memory itself keeps everything — this only decides how much goes into the context: higher remembers more and costs more tokens. Global default, shared by every pet (a pet pack may override it in its own kind file).
en.configMetaHint: User config may override pets / animation pools / weights — refresh or restart to apply: refresh the page in the browser, or right-click a desktop pet → "Reload config" (rebuilds every desktop pet window). The default config is the complete reference.
en.confineToggleHint: Multi-monitor: when on, the pet stays inside the screen it is currently on — a thrown pet bounces only inside the screen it was released on (screen seams act as walls, so it never flies to the neighbouring monitor), and autonomous wandering only walks within the screen it is currently on (a step that would cross the seam is simply cancelled). Turn this off to let it cross screens as usual. Desktop only — the browser overlay always stays inside the viewport anyway.
en.confirmSync: Sync? This overwrites the user config with the bundled default config (all fields + comments); current customizations are lost.
en.cornerHint: Which screen corner the pet sticks to (per-monitor work area in desktop mode).
en.corruptBody: The user config file cannot be parsed (corrupted, not valid JSON/JSONC): {path}. Saving now rebuilds it from the whitelist — everything currently in that file (animations / physics / memes …) will be lost. Cancel = leave the file untouched (fix it and save again); Confirm = save anyway (discard what is in the file).
en.corruptTitle: User config is corrupted — not saved
en.displayHint: web = browser only / desktop = desktop only / both = both / none = neither
en.emptyPets: No pets yet — click "Add pet" to create one.
en.extraPetsHint: {n} extra pet(s) are file-defined in the pet/ directory (<name>-config.json + <name>-animation/ + <name>-memes/). They are not in this list — after editing the files, refresh the page (browser) or right-click a desktop pet → "Reload config".
en.fixedEnabledHint: When enabled, the random chain no longer turns this pet or walks it away — only idle and in-place actions play. Right-click picks, API triggers and balance / whisper / work-status animations are unaffected.
en.fontFamilyHint: "Candy (bundled)" ships with the plugin; the others are system fonts. If a font is missing on this machine, it falls back to the next one in the stack (never blank, never an error).
en.fontFollowToggleHint: On (default): the font grows with the pet — at 462 px width it is exactly the size above. Off: the size stays fixed regardless of pet size.
en.fontHint: The family applies to every place that currently uses the candy font: pet bubble, hover tooltip, chat popup, score popup. The size applies only to the pet bubble and the hover tooltip (chat and score popups keep their own size). Global default, shared by every pet (a pet pack may override it in its own kind file); written to the user config on "Save" — instant in the browser, and on the desktop it applies once Save reloads the pet windows.
en.fontSizeHint: Bubble body text size; the tooltip and the smaller lines inside the bubble scale proportionally. Range 4–200.
en.globalHint: Shared by every pet (a pet pack may override them in its own kind file). These switches only change local state and are written to the user config on "Save" (never written immediately); system notifications re-read right after saving, no page refresh needed.
en.intro: Manage multiple pets: each pet has its own size and position (applies instantly after saving).
en.invalid: Check your input: size must be positive; margins can be any number.
en.invalidChatImageLimit: Check the chat image limit: it must be a number ≥ 0 (0 = no limit).
en.invalidChatMemory: Check the chat history rounds: it must be a number ≥ 0.
en.invalidFont: Check the font settings: the family must be in the list and the size must be a number between 4 and 200.
en.invalidModel: Check the model settings: pick both a provider and a model, or leave both empty (follow the current conversation).
en.invalidPhysics: Check the physics values: gravity / ground friction ≥ 0, bounciness 0–1, throw power > 0.
en.marginXHint: Horizontal distance from the chosen corner (px); any number.
en.marginYHint: Vertical distance from the chosen corner (px); any number.
en.modelCatalogFailed: Failed to load the model list (refresh the page to retry); your current values are kept as they are.
en.modelFieldHint: "Follow current conversation" uses the conversation model; if a chosen model fails, the plugin falls back to the conversation model and retries once.
en.modelHint: Which model each of whisper and chat uses, and how much history every chat request carries. "Follow current conversation" uses the model your current conversation is on (default). Global default: applies to every pet, and a pet pack may override it in its own kind file. The options come from the same source as the DSH model picker, served live by the host.
en.modelNone: No models available for this provider
en.nameHint: Shown on hover and added to AI personas ("your name is X"). Duplicates allowed; empty falls back to the pet id.
en.notifyDenyBlocked: Notification permission is blocked by the browser.
en.notifyDenyRejected: You chose "Block" in the permission prompt.
en.notifyDenyUnsupported: System notifications are not supported in this environment (no Notification API).
en.notifyGuide: Guide: click the 🔒/ⓘ icon next to the address bar → Site settings → Notifications → set to "Allow", then refresh and retry.
en.notifyTestOk: Test notification sent — check the bottom-right of your desktop.
en.notifyToggleHint: OS-level toasts (bottom-right of the desktop) for conversation completion, failures, permission requests, and questions — only while this window is unfocused.
en.personaHint: Applies to this pet only. Leave empty to follow the entry persona — the grey text inside the box is exactly that. The system prompt actually sent = this text + an appended 「your name is "<name>"」 line + the current time context, so do not repeat the name or the date here.
en.petCardHint: Per-pet settings: name / size / display / corner / offsets / the four feature switches. Click "Save" at the bottom to apply instantly.
en.physics.gravityHint: px/s² — the higher, the faster it falls; 0 = weightless (flies straight forever)
en.physics.groundFrictionHint: per second, horizontal damping while on the ground; 0 = frictionless ice
en.physics.restitutionHint: 0–1, speed kept when bouncing off a wall or the floor (1 = perfectly elastic, 0 = stops dead)
en.physics.throwPowerHint: > 0, overall multiplier for spring tracking and release speed (1 = default; higher = tighter tracking, harder throws)
en.physicsCeilingBounceHint: Turn this off to let a throw fly out through the top of the screen (gravity still pulls it back)
en.physicsHint: Global default, shared by every pet (a pet pack may override it in its own kind file); written to the user config on "Save" (never written immediately). Applies instantly in the browser; on the desktop it applies once Save reloads the pet windows.
en.physicsPetCollisionHint: A flying pet bounces off the others with momentum conservation (mass ∝ size²)
en.storage.desktopCache: Desktop pet window cache and primary-monitor scale cache (safe to delete, rebuilt automatically)
en.storage.electron: Electron runtime used by the desktop pet (large; re-downloaded automatically the next time desktop mode starts)
en.storage.electronCache: Electron installer download cache (safe to delete, re-downloaded when needed)
en.storage.package: The plugin itself (managed by DSH — remove it with the command below instead of deleting it)
en.storage.userData: Plugin user data: custom config main-config.jsonc, chat memory memory.json, custom animation assets main-animation/, file pets pet/
en.storageHint: Every location this plugin writes to. Deleting cache folders is harmless (they re-download / rebuild); deleting "plugin user data" loses your config and chat memory.
en.syncHint: "Sync" writes the bundled default config (comments + every advanced field included) to the user config file, overwriting your current customizations; the file is then directly editable. Two caveats: (1) once created, that file is an explicit override layer — later changes to the bundled defaults will not take effect automatically (until you sync again or delete the file); (2) clicking "Save" on this page rewrites the file from a whitelist — field values are kept, comments are dropped.
en.uninstallStep1: 1. Quit DSH first (the desktop pet exits with it); do not delete these files while the pet is running.
en.uninstallStep2: 2. Remove the plugin itself (run in a terminal; this also drops it from the profile bundle layer):
en.uninstallStep3: 3. Delete the locations above as needed: cache folders are harmless; deleting "plugin user data" loses your config and chat memory (back up main-config.jsonc first if you want to keep it).
en.whisperEnabledHint: When enabled, this pet periodically generates a line via AI and plays the whisper animation (persona = the field below; empty follows the entry).
en.whisperImageToggleHint: Attach one random meme from the pool to each whisper line (image mapping lives in the top-level `memes` config field). Tokens: a whisper already calls the model every cycle, so the image only appends the name + description of that one meme (~100 chars / ~60 tokens) to the same request — negligible.
en.workStatusEnabledHint: When enabled, this pet follows DSH work state: thinking / working / waiting / done / error switch animations and show bubbles (pool in top-level config; listening only, no model calls).
